QUOTE: `createPost` in the client (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:43`) sends `noRetry: true`. `buildRequestOptions` (`app/client/rest/tracking.ts:378`) turns that into `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`. The send is attempted once.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the create-post request has noRetry set, with a retry limit of 0, so it is sent once and never retried automatically.
